Workflow.Name: SRM Data Collection - Retrieve Coface data
Workflow.Description: Agent tool: retrieves the mock Coface record for a request (DUNS match, or a name and country shortlist without a DUNS), checks the data age against the configured window, writes the Coface columns to the request, logs the action and emails the reviewer. Skips requests that reuse a GSA rating.
